anger-orange.$description: Anger Orange — Primary brand canvas and surface fill — hero backgrounds, section dividers, and headline text. The entire site is painted in this color; restraint is not the goal

sun-yellow.$description: Sun Yellow — Display type, starburst badges, and decorative graphic fills. Sits on top of orange sections for maximum contrast and excitement

royal-blue.$description: Royal Blue — Outlined link and icon border color — used as a chromatic accent stroke for interactive elements and decorative icon outlines against the orange field

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Primary text and structural border color. Near-black but slightly warm — softer than pure black, used for body copy, dividers, and image borders

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Button borders, link text, and SVG fills. Reserved for the sharpest contrast moments where pure black is needed over lighter surfaces

blush-peach.$description: Blush Peach — Soft secondary surface — pastel section background that breaks the orange dominance and introduces a calmer band for content

cream.$description: Cream — Softest surface tint and decorative shape fill in pink sections. Functions as a quiet third surface level above blush

lemon-cream.$description: Lemon Cream — Secondary yellow used in decorative shapes and softer accent fills where pure sun-yellow would be too aggressive

rightgrotesk-spatialblack-webfont.$description: Display and heading typeface. Ultra-wide, compressed-black sans with near-zero leading (0.89) that makes headlines read as solid slabs. This is the signature voice — every page must use it for its loudest statements.

nimbus-sans-extended-bold.$description: Secondary body emphasis type. Heavy negative tracking at 23px gives a chunky condensed feel for subheadings or emphasized inline copy.

nimbus-sans-extended-regular.$description: Extended sans for body and subheading roles where rightgrotesk would be too heavy. Tight 0.89 leading on the 36px size is an intentional match to the display voice.

open-sans.$description: Readable body and hero paragraph text. At 1.67 leading on 22px, it's the quiet voice for longer passages; at 1.00 on 18px, it acts as a dense label.

obviously-condensed-semibold.$description: Link and CTA typeface. Condensed semibold for narrow, punchy action labels.
